quizGuardRationale: Direct declarations are symmetric in the app, not transitive; original baseline declarations are preserved.
貸し出し/貸し/貸す overlap in lending despite noun/verb and favor meanings. Rental room/house labels are checked against the ordinary room/house labels, not confused with the rent payment.
過失 protects error, fault/defect and accident labels while explaining negligence; this is not a claim that every accident or defect entails negligence.
果実/果物 exact fruit titles already deduplicate; 実 needs its own direct pair.
個所 protects place/point/part/passage labels, including English textual/physical/legislative passage ambiguity, not unrestricted substitution among all Japanese passage words.
過剰 comparisons include surplus/exceeding labels and applicable excessive adverb senses. The remainder noun of 1584930 is restricted to あまり, not automatically transferred to あんまり.
かじる comparisons protect physical chewing/biting and shallow-learning/knowing overlap without asserting expertise or unrestricted synonymy.
課税 tax overlap is supported by actual Japanese assessed-tax recognition. Paying and collecting taxes are different actions, not automatically synonyms of imposing tax.
下線/線 and カセット/テープ protect specific/general line and recording-medium labels; a recorder is different from its cassette.
加速/加速度 share acceleration labels while action and measured rate remain distinguished.
片付く protects tidying, completion and resolution meanings across grammatical viewpoints. 固まる/片付く/決まる can share firm/settled outcomes without becoming universally interchangeable.
塊 comparisons protect actual mass/bundle/group/crowd senses and English noun/verb bundle polysemy; not a claim that every formal organization is a dense mass.
固まる protects solidifying/freezing, gathering, settled plans and computing stop/freeze/hang labels. Computing hang is not physical hanging.
傾く comparisons cover inclination, trend, downward change/sinking and English decline polysemy. 片寄る/傾く is a separate direct pair; exclusions through a third card do not imply it.
片道/往復 contrast journey directions, not synonymous labels. 片仮名/平仮名/漢字 contrast scripts rather than forming an exclusion clique.
sourceAccessLimits: Actual-entry receipts record author inspection, not fresh independent reviewer retrieval. The 箇所 heading-only lookup is explicitly unsuccessful evidence.
Complete principal/comparison families and raw source fields remain intact even when practical selected senses omit specialist, historical or marriage uses.
No original-source error is silently repaired: the transitive-sounding 片付く gloss is qualified using the actual intransitive identity.
Ten primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs are added on 個, 課, 税, 線, 片, 固 and 傾. 固 also links its existing 固まり example to the article explicitly recognizing that alias.
The alias 固/塊 link is useful navigation but is not counted by the mechanical primary-written-component reciprocal-pair metric.
仮, 偏, 剰, 噛, 囓, 塊, 箇 and 齧 lack character cards across recorded alternative spellings. All written primary characters remain in metadata without speculative new kanji/stroke files or broken links.
Existing 貸す, 片付ける, 噛む, 食べる, 往復, テープ, ラジオカセット and ラジカセ gain narrow navigation links only; stable identity, reading, title, levels and original exclusions remain unchanged.
Dictionary ordering and priority flags are not measured frequency; recorded/search-only spellings and restricted kana-only readings are not promoted to unrestricted forms.
Original teaching examples are authored sentences, not represented as quotations or independent corpus attestations. Mechanical validation is not linguistic certification.

Both permit a plan or arrangement becoming settled. Guards through 決まる or 片付く are not transitive.
The be-settled and settle labels overlap the explicitly taught resolution of a matter.
English finish is unmarked for transitivity in the existing title. The intransitive and transitive Japanese constructions remain distinct.
Embodiment is explicit in 塊 1590410:3 and the existing 具体 answer label; physical-mass guards do not protect that figurative sense.
Place/location labels overlap despite the more specific spot-counting and position descriptions.

teachingClarifications: 貸家 explains 家 as や in かしや and いえ in the restricted かしいえ alternative. The allowed spellings and primary reading are unchanged.
片仮名 and カタカナ have the same pronunciation. The ordinary kana spelling is explained without exposing dictionary storage conventions to learners.
片寄る retains 偏る recognition and demonstrates it in the biased-view example. Both spellings can cover physical or figurative imbalance; no strict sense partition is added.
課税's subject and に-marked taxed item are stated positively. 傾く's agreement example and translation are tightened without an unstated proposal.
optionalLeadLimits: Dictionary headword order and priority tags do not establish that 偏る is more frequent, nor that one spelling predominates in a particular sense. No new frequency claim is added. The spelling example is an optional recognition improvement.
The complete 1590410 family supports a mass or group of people. The optional ひとかたまり wording is not required to correct an established lexical defect, and the original group example is retained.
An optional 箇所 preference is not asserted from dictionary order. The noun and counter spelling restrictions remain explicit.

Specialized building subtypes (multistory building, apartment building, two-story building), lodging and respectful/possessive home labels are not automatically synonymous with a rental house. The bounded housing follow-through adds the four broader house/building/residence labels above, not a whole-topic exclusion clique.
